info.title: Furniture Rendering Bulk Backend
info.description: Service-to-service bulk API using private Azure Blob Storage. Upload URLs are 15-minute HTTPS blob-scoped write SAS; PUT raw bytes with the returned Content-Type and x-ms-blob-type: BlockBlob headers, then verify. Download URLs are fresh 15-minute read-only SAS. Persist resource IDs, never SAS URLs. Request uploads only after folder confirmation. Relative paths must not contain empty, dot, dot-dot, backslash or control-character segments. See rendering-backend.md for cross-field constraints and examples.
